label: scam
text: Hi, this message is for the beneficiary at this number. This is Denise Harlow calling from the Social Security benefits adjustment unit. We're reviewing the cost-of-living increase on your record and it looks like your new monthly amount couldn't be applied because one item needs to be confirmed with you. It only takes a couple of minutes. When you have a moment, please give me a call back at 202-555-0134 and reference file twenty-two. Thank you so much, and have a good afternoon.

label: scam
text: IRS Notice: Your 2025 tax refund of $1,318.00 has been approved but is on hold because your direct deposit information could not be verified. To release your refund, please confirm your details at https://irs-refundstatus.example.org/verify within 5 business days. Thank you for filing.

label: scam
text: Good morning, my name is Gary Whitfield and I'm with Medicare enrollment services. We're sending out the new plastic Medicare cards with the security chip this month, and I just need to confirm your Medicare number so yours doesn't get delayed. Do you have your current card handy? If now isn't good, you can reach me directly at 202-555-0151.

label: scam
text: Medi-Cal: Su cobertura vence el 31 de octubre. Para evitar la cancelacion, complete su renovacion en linea hoy en https://benefitscal-renovar.example.net. Solo toma 5 minutos. Tenga a mano su numero de Seguro Social y su tarjeta bancaria para verificar su identidad.

label: scam
text: Covered California Member Services: Our records show you were overcharged on your premium this year because your tax credit was not applied correctly. You are eligible for a refund of $642.18. To receive it by direct deposit, reply with your bank routing and account number, or call our refund desk at 202-555-0127. Refunds not claimed in 10 days are returned to the state.

label: scam
text: Hi this is Rebecca, I'm your new CalFresh worker at the county since Maria transferred out. Your benefits for next month are on hold until I can verify your EBT card is still in your possession. Can you text me a photo of the front of the card and the 4 digit PIN so I can match it in our system? Sorry for the hassle, I'm trying to get everyone done before Friday.

text: Aviso EBT California: Detectamos actividad inusual y su tarjeta EBT fue bloqueada temporalmente. Para reactivarla y no perder sus beneficios de este mes, verifique su tarjeta en https://ebt-ca.example.com/activar

text: PG&E: A technician is scheduled to replace your SmartMeter tomorrow between 9am and 1pm. text: Hola, le llamamos del departamento de cobranzas de PG&E. Su cuenta tiene un saldo vencido y el tecnico ya esta en camino para desconectar su servicio hoy antes de las 5 de la tarde. text: Congratulations! Because you receive CalFresh or Medi-Cal, you are pre-approved for a FREE 5G smartphone and unlimited data through the government Lifeline program. text: Hi, is this Tanya? We met at the senior center resource fair last week and you said you wanted help with your benefits paperwork. Oh sorry, wrong number I think! Well, you sound nice anyway. I actually help people stretch their fixed income, I made an extra $800 last month with a small savings app my cousin showed me. Happy to walk you through it if you ever want, no pressure at all.

label: scam
text: Buenas tardes, soy Lorena, trabajo ayudando a familias a solicitar CalFresh y Medi-Cal. Vi que usted pregunto en el grupo de la comunidad. Yo le hago toda la solicitud por WhatsApp para que no tenga que ir a la oficina. Solo necesito una foto de su identificacion, su numero de Seguro Social y un pago de $35 por Zelle para empezar el tramite hoy mismo.

label: scam
text: Este es un mensaje de la Administracion del Seguro Social. Su numero de Seguro Social ha sido suspendido por actividad sospechosa en el estado de Texas. Antes de que se tome accion legal, presione 1 o llame al 202-555-0109 para hablar con un oficial. Gracias.

label: scam
text: FINAL NOTICE OF INTENT TO LEVY. Our records indicate an unresolved balance of $2,184.60 for tax year 2023. Because prior notices were not answered, a levy on your wages and state benefits will be issued within 48 hours of the date of this notice. To place an immediate hold, you must speak with the Case Resolution Officer at 202-555-0188 today. Payment can be made through a Treasury payment voucher purchased at an authorized retail location.

text: Hello, I'm calling on behalf of a Medicare-approved lab. Because of your age you qualify for a free hereditary cancer screening kit, fully covered by Medicare at no cost to you. We just need to confirm your Medicare ID and your doctor's name so we can mail the kit this week. Call us back at 202-555-0176.

label: scam
text: Covered California: Su plan de salud sera cancelado hoy a medianoche por falta de pago de la prima de octubre ($18.00). Para mantener su cobertura, llame a su agente asignado, Sr. Morales, al 202-555-0122 y pague con tarjeta de debito por telefono.

label: scam
text: Hi, this is Kevin Duarte from the county social services office calling about your Medi-Cal renewal. This year we're doing renewals over the phone to save you a trip. I'll need to confirm your Social Security number and the bank account where your income is deposited so we can calculate your share of cost. Please call me back at 202-555-0158, my direct line, before Thursday so your coverage isn't interrupted.

text: Hey neighbor, it's Alicia from the caregivers support group chat. I know money's tight for a lot of us on SSI. text: SUN Bucks Summer EBT: Your household has $120 per child in unclaimed summer food benefits. Benefits expire at the end of this month. Claim and load them to your EBT card at https://sunbucks-claim.example.org with your card number and PIN.

text: PG&E Alert: Due to forecasted high winds and dry conditions, PG&E may need to turn off power to your area to reduce wildfire risk. A Public Safety Power Shutoff could begin as early as Wednesday evening and may last 24 to 48 hours or longer. Please prepare now: charge devices and plan for medical needs. Updates at pge.com/outages.

text: PG&E: Your account is past due. A balance of $212.40 must be paid by October 21 to avoid service disconnection. Pay online at pge.com, through the PG&E app, or call the number on your bill. If you are having trouble paying, ask about payment arrangements and the CARE program, which may lower your bill.

label: legit
text: Alerta de PG&E: Debido a vientos fuertes y condiciones secas, PG&E podria cortar la electricidad en su area para reducir el riesgo de incendios forestales. El corte podria comenzar el jueves por la noche y durar uno o dos dias. Preparese ahora: cargue sus dispositivos y tenga un plan si usa equipo medico. Mas informacion en pge.com/outages.

label: legit
text: Notice CP14. We show you owe $386.52 for tax year 2024. This includes tax, penalties and interest. If you agree, pay the amount due by the date on this notice to avoid additional penalty and interest. You can pay online at irs.gov/payments or mail a check with the payment stub. If you can't pay in full, you may be able to set up a payment plan at irs.gov/paymentplan. If you disagree, call the number listed on the top right of this notice.

label: legit
text: Aviso del IRS (por correo). Segun nuestros registros, usted tiene un saldo pendiente de $1,042.00 del ano tributario 2023. Este es un recordatorio de que aun no hemos recibido su pago. Si no paga o se comunica con nosotros, podriamos presentar un aviso de gravamen. Puede pagar en irs.gov/pagos o solicitar un plan de pagos. Si tiene preguntas, llame al numero que aparece en la parte superior de este aviso.

label: legit
text: Your Medi-Cal renewal is due. We mailed you a renewal packet. Please fill it out, sign it and return it by the due date on the packet, or renew online at benefitscal.com. If we do not get your information, your Medi-Cal may end. If you have questions or need help, call your county office using the number on your packet.

label: legit
text: Recordatorio de Medi-Cal: Su paquete de renovacion vence pronto. Si no lo devuelve antes de la fecha indicada, su cobertura de Medi-Cal podria terminar. Puede renovar en linea en benefitscal.com, por correo, o en persona en la oficina de su condado. Si necesita ayuda, llame a la oficina de su condado al numero que aparece en su carta.

label: legit
text: NOTICE OF APPOINTMENT. Your CalFresh recertification interview is scheduled by telephone on October 14 at 10:30 a.m. Your county worker will call you at the phone number we have on file. If you cannot keep this appointment, or if you need to give us a new phone number, please call your worker at the number on this notice before your appointment. If you miss your interview, your CalFresh benefits may stop at the end of the month.

label: legit
text: CA EBT: Your CalFresh benefits for this month have been deposited to your EBT card. To check your balance, visit ebt.ca.gov or use the number on the back of your card. Remember: the EBT program will never call or text to ask for your PIN.

label: legit
text: Your new benefit amount. Beginning in January, your Social Security benefit will increase because of a cost-of-living adjustment. The letter shows your monthly amount before deductions, your Medicare premium, and the amount you will receive. You do not need to do anything. You can also view this notice online by signing in to your my Social Security account at ssa.gov/myaccount.

label: legit
text: Notice of Overpayment. We paid you $1,140.00 more than you were due in Supplemental Security Income between March and June because your reported wages were higher than we had on record. You have the right to appeal within 60 days if you disagree, or to ask us to waive collection if the overpayment was not your fault and you cannot afford to pay it back. If we do not hear from you within 30 days, we will begin withholding a portion of your monthly payment. You can contact your local Social Security office or visit ssa.gov.

label: legit
text: Covered California: Necesitamos que nos envie un comprobante de ingresos para confirmar su ayuda financiera. Tiene 90 dias a partir de la fecha de esta carta para cargar sus documentos en su cuenta en coveredca.com o enviarlos por correo. Si no recibimos los documentos, su ayuda financiera podria cambiar o terminar.

label: legit
text: Vehicle Registration Renewal Notice. Your vehicle registration expires on November 30. A smog certification is required for this renewal. Renew online at dmv.ca.gov, at a DMV kiosk, by mail using the enclosed envelope, or at a DMV office. Late fees will be added if payment is received after the expiration date.

text: EDD reminder: It's time to certify for continued Unemployment Insurance benefits. Log in to your myEDD account at edd.ca.gov to complete your certification. If you do not certify within 14 days, you may not be paid for those weeks. EDD will never ask for your password by text.

text: Medicare Summary Notice for Part B. This is not a bill.
